exposure: Breakfast after the bell (BAB) program adoption
cohort: The study compared schools adopting the Breakfast after the Bell (BAB) program to synthetic control schools, focusing on third-grade children in Arkansas.
finding: The study found little evidence of positive or negative effects of Breakfast after the Bell (BAB) on math and literacy test scores, with some transitory negative effects on math for specific subgroups that were no longer present by the time the first fully exposed cohort reached third grade.
